description: init's superset for a project that might already have code in it. On an empty project_dir, behaves exactly like init — scaffolds each requested client's project-instructions file, nothing more. On a project_dir that already has files in it, does that AND returns complianceChecklist: concrete things to go find and fix in the existing code so it actually follows WiseWall's gating conventions (remove any client-side-only paywall logic, move hardcoded API keys to set_secret + /_gk/proxy, set protectedPaths/authOnlyPaths to match the app's real premium content, flag rather than silently replace any existing sign-in system). This tool only writes the instructions file(s) itself — it has no code-editing judgment of its own, so acting on complianceChecklist against this project's actual source files is on you, the calling agent, the same way each checklist item is worded. Same defaults and client set as init — call this instead of init whenever project_dir isn't a fresh empty folder.

clients.description: Which clients' instructions files to write. Defaults to all six.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the project's root directory (not the build output/dist_dir).

name: convert
title: Convert an existing project to WiseWall
